TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage: bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design, photographed flat under soft room light.
2. One flat block-colour paper ground fills the frame: deep magenta. The ground is a single unbroken colour.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Every cutout is a plain, unmarked object: calendar pages, documents, coins, screens and vehicles are blank and unprinted, with no lettering, numerals, symbols, liveries or marks on them.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons in cream, black, pale yellow, or the ground's contrasting colour, with real paper texture, print dots and small pieces of tape.
5. One consistent light from the upper left; each paper layer casts a small soft shadow.
6. Every surface is matte printed paper reflecting only the room light: cutouts, chips, ribbons and ground all read as photographed paper, with the same flat finish edge to edge. No glow, neon, bloom or halo anywhere.
7. Layout: the headline chip owns the upper third of the frame and stays uncovered; subjects and diagrams occupy the lower two-thirds. When the frame opens on a previous composition, its elements slide off or are covered in the first second and the new headline lands on clear ground.
8. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif in black or cream, printed on a cream or black paper chip, large, with safe margins. Letterforms are accurate, complete and stable from the frame they appear in; the chip is printed once and does not redraw.
9. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window; one strongest focus at a time; the camera is locked; movement starts on the first frame and a small loop continues at the end; no empty frames.
10. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
11. Identity anchor: rough white torn edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from the upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: deep magenta.
Subjects: a torn-paper arrow; paper coins.
Opens on the row of buildings, carried over from the previous shot, which transforms as the action begins.
Action: The previous chip flips off as the buildings collapse into paper coins; a torn-paper arrow enters and points down at them.

ON-SCREEN TEXT: "$1.16". This string is printed complete and correct from its first visible frame and never changes. It is the only lettering in the frame.

AUDIO: One English narrator, warm, clear, natural, brisk but unhurried, never an advertising shout. Speak the following line exactly once, word for word, beginning on the first frame: "The stock trades at one dollar sixteen, capitalised near thirty-four million.". No other dialogue. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects beneath the voice; no music.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] This is a modern editorial paper collage in a cinematic 2D motion design style, photographed flat under soft, natural room light coming from the upper left. <Picture 1> serves as the first frame, featuring a light-blue paper ground, a cream paper chip with the black text "BANKS & FUNDS", and a row of black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts of buildings with rough white torn-paper edges resting on a conveyor belt. Immediately upon onset, the light-blue ground is swiftly covered by a single, unbroken block of deep magenta paper. Simultaneously, the "BANKS & FUNDS" chip flips upward and off-screen with a fast, snappy motion. The buildings collapse downward, transforming into a scattered pile of black-and-white halftone paper coins, all featuring rough white torn edges and blank, unprinted surfaces. A cream paper chip with the black, extra-bold sans-serif text "$1.16" slides in quickly from the top, landing stably in the upper third of the frame with a slight overshoot. Simultaneously, a black-and-white halftone paper arrow with rough white torn edges enters from the right, sliding fast to point directly down at the pile of paper coins. Every element, including the coins and the arrow, casts a small, soft shadow to the bottom right, emphasizing the physical paper layers. The camera remains a Static Shot throughout. By the end of the 5-second duration, the composition holds steady on the "$1.16" headline and the downward-pointing arrow, with a subtle, rhythmic pulsing loop of the arrow's position. A warm, clear, natural-toned male narrator (S1) says in a brisk but unhurried delivery: <d>[English] The stock trades at one dollar sixteen, capitalised near thirty-four million.</d>
